parse_notes: Closed local observations on frozen synthetic benches. No generated answer, prompt, answer key, weight or machine log is published; no role is adopted.

Sage-A1.5 (InternScience), GGUF Q4_K_M (the publisher's own conversion), on the NVLink pair with -ts 19,22: all 41 layers (and the output layer) on GPU, the MoE experts included (--n-cpu-moe 0), 16,384-token context, one llama.cpp slot, so the eight requests of the house protocol are served one after another.

Same weights and image as sage-a1.5-one-card, the conditional arm on the other topology. Single stream 164.5 tok/s against 164.5 for sage-a1.5-one-card, aggregate 165.3 against 165.6 (three passes each, one slot): no difference in single stream with one card beyond the spread of the three passes.
The predeclared fit search loaded at its first setting (6.4 s).

Picked from a public model watch, downloaded at a fixed revision and checked by SHA-256, with its arms written and its fit searched before they ran; the conditional arm on the other topology ran after this model's planned arms had finished.

Run from 11:11 UTC to 12:02 UTC on 2 November, in a day window opened with the owner's go-ahead after the model watch, on the host's first pair. The other pair was out of service: one of its cards had fallen off the bus at 11:07 UTC, before these arms, and its machine was stopped at 11:29 UTC. At the first arm's start no process ran on it; at the later arms it no longer answered.
